enemyBoard_rec1.text: No quarter! Take the ship! Make 'em walk the plank!

sunk_rec1.text: Huzzah! Send her to Davy Jones!

bossArrived_rec1.text: That be the captain's own galleon. Steady, lads. There's money in a pack.

voyageWon_rec1.text: Yo ho ho! The voyage be won, me hearties!

sighted_rec1.text: Arr, there she be, matey! Sail off the bow!

hooked_rec1.text: Arr, we hooked her, matey! Haulin' her alongside!

lashed_rec1.text: She's lashed alongside! Over the rail, me hearties!
